BiblicalUsage: Nasak means to interweave or overspread, to cast a covering over, and its only occurrence is a veil over the nations. In Isaiah 25:7 the Lord will destroy in His mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the veil over the nations is the darkness that keeps people from seeing God, and Isaiah says the Lord Himself will destroy it; the covering is not lifted by us; it is torn by Him.
